incidents.text: It's a goal! Mikel Oyarzabal plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Lamine Yamal (Spain). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Aymeric Laporte knock down. 2:0.
Goal! Dani Olmo gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 3:0.
Today's referee Raphael Claus rightly decides to book Salem Al Dawsari (Saudi Arabia) for his harsh tackle.
Luis de la Fuente makes a half-time substitution. Yeremy Pino comes on in place of Lamine Yamal (Spain).
Luis de la Fuente makes a switch. Ferran Torres is coming on in place of Mikel Oyarzabal (Spain) at the start of the second period.
Half-time substitution. Georgios Donis decided to make a change. Abdullah Al Khaibari (Saudi Arabia) is replaced by Mohamed Kanno.
Half-time substitution. Musab Al Juwayr (Saudi Arabia) will not participate anymore and Abdullah Al Hamdan is coming on.
Hassan Tambakti (Saudi Arabia) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
Raphael Claus shows a yellow card to Mohamed Kanno (Saudi Arabia), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
Georgios Donis has decided to make a change. Alaa Hejji (Saudi Arabia) replaces Abdulelah Al Amri.
It's time for a substitution. Mohammed Abu Al Shamat (Saudi Arabia) comes on in place of Firas Al Buraikan.
The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mikel Merino (Spain) will replace Dani Olmo.
That will be all from Alex Baena who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nico Williams (Spain).
That's the end of the game for Pedri, who is replaced by Fabian Ruiz (Spain).
Substitution. Nasser Al Dawsari walks off the pitch and Khalid Al Ghannam (Saudi Arabia) comes on as a substitute.
